brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.requirement: A planter of four cells (four planting bins)
requirements.evidence: Four bases (0..3,0,0), each with a hex-bin-third-drain bin.

requirements.requirement: Each of the four cells holds soil for planting
requirements.evidence: All four bins are filled with soil and planted (prop:1 to prop:4).

requirements.requirement: A water pipe runs through the bases
requirements.evidence: run:run-1, in irrigation mode, laid through the bases at level 0.

requirements.requirement: The pipe feeds every cell (passes through all four cells)
requirements.evidence: The run goes in at cell (0,0) and passes through (1,0), (2,0) and (3,0), so it reaches all four cells, each with a drain bin above it. The configurator can't check whether water actually reaches each bin or whether anything leaks.

finish.summary: I built a four-cell planter: four bases in a straight line, each holding a soil-filled drain bin with a plant in it. One irrigation-mode pipe run (run-1) goes in at the open west face of the first cell and runs straight through all four bases. I kept the pipe straight because a straight run leaves room for shallow (third-depth) bins in every cell. Open faces are capped and the joints are bolted, 29 parts in all. The build check found no rule issues and no mesh clashes, and no props were flagged. The configurator only checks fit, so whether the pipe and bins are actually watertight can't be checked here.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
